claim.claim-text: 1. A method comprising: performing by processing circuitry of a Radio Access Network, RAN, node, the processing circuitry in communication with a Non-Real-Time RAN Intelligent Controller, Non-RT RIC, of a Service Management and Orchestration, SMO, entity of an Open RAN, O-RAN, and a Near-RT RIC in the O-RAN: configuring the RAN node for multi-access network traffic management in the O-RAN, the configuring comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the spectrum utilization information is associated with at least one of:
3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the spectrum adjustment policy further indicates one or more preferences on which cells to allocate control plane and user plane functions.
4. The method of any of claims 1-3, wherein the spectrum adjustment policy further indicates at least one of quality of service, QoS, targets, a bearer selection, and a bearer type change.

5. The method of any of claims 1-4, wherein the spectrum utilization information includes intra-radio access technology, RAT, and inter-RAT measurement reports, cell quality thresholds, cell global identity, CGI, reports, and measurement gaps on per-UE basis.

6. The method of any of claims 1-5, wherein the spectrum utilization information includes intra-radio access technology, RAT, and inter-RAT measurement reports, cell quality thresholds, cell global identity, CGI, reports, and measurement gaps on per-frequency basis.
7. An apparatus to be used in a Radio Access Network, RAN, node, the apparatus comprising:

Processing circuitry in communication with a Non-Real-Time RAN Intelligent Controller, Non-RT RIC, of a Service Management and Orchestration, SMO, entity of an Open RAN, O-RAN, and a Near-RT RIC in the O-RAN, and a memory coupled to the processing circuitry, characterized in that, to configure the RAN node for multi-access network traffic management in the O-RAN, the processing circuitry is configured to perform a method configured according to any of claims 1-6.

8. A computer-readable storage medium that stores instructions for execution by one or more processors of a Service Management and Orchestration, SMO, entity of an Open RAN, O-RAN, the instructions to configure the SMO entity for multi-access network traffic management in the O-RAN by causing the SMO entity to perform a method configured according to any of claims 1-6.
